suggestions.topic: EIP-8253 Glamsterdam vs Hegota final decision
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDT #95 to tomorrow's ACDE (Sept 11). ACDT rough consensus was Hegota, but formal decision needed. If ACDE reverses to Glamsterdam inclusion, would require immediate client implementation.

suggestions.topic: glamsterdam-devnet-11 launch status and L2 coordination readiness
suggestions.rationale: Devnet-11 blocked on Prysm alpha.14 merge as of ACDT #95. This is the final happy-path fork transition devnet before testnet launches; critical for L2 teams to coordinate. Confirm readiness and timeline.

ACDT #95 showed Jochem's 64KB JUMPDEST-spam knocked out 12/13 Besu nodes (65% missed proposals vs 0.1% Geth). This is a critical pre-testnet blocker. Confirm fix status and whether EEST can express this attack for ongoing testing.

suggestions.topic: Nimbus PTC voting-too-early bug from worst-case blob payload
suggestions.rationale: Surfaced by Toni's attack testing on devnet-8; still under investigation per ACDT #95. Could impact testnet stability if unresolved.

ACDT #93 targeted mid-to-end September for Sepolia shadow fork. We're now in that window. Confirm readiness of client releases, devnet-11 completion status, and whether Snap2 testing is ready to begin.

suggestions.topic: glamsterdam-devnet-9 Prysm trunk offline incident post-mortem
suggestions.rationale: ~30% of devnet-9 (Prysm trunk) went offline at Gloas fork; Lighthouse had OOM issues with 4M validator keys. Network was not kept running. Understanding root cause is important before scaling to testnet.

suggestions.topic: Payload-flooding attack retest status on devnet-8
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDT #91 to devnet-8. ACDT #93 and #95 show Toni conducted various attack tests, but no explicit confirmation that the duplicate envelope fix was retested. Low priority since other attack vectors have been tested and devnet-8 is running well.
